notes: Flow interrogation log: captures the rationale for each trade (exit/entry/trim) — populated by interactive runs asking 'why' and by scheduled runs writing 'UNCAPTURED' for manual review. Each entry: {date, ticker, action ('exit'|'trim'|'entry'), qty_change, price_at_trade, reason ('dollar-cost-averaging'|'stop-loss'|'thesis-change'|'raise-cash'|'rebalance'|UNCAPTURED, or free text if the user typed something not on that list), notes}. Enables sell-discipline tracking and proposal scoring against actual user behavior. | SEEDED 2026-07-28: back-filled the 07-24 and 07-27 stop-out events (reconstructed, fills approximate) and the 07-28 redeployment (fills exact). G26 now has data for the first time. | 2026-07-29: 'dollar-cost-averaging' promoted from a free-text answer to a full 5th standard reason (see G35, TRADE RATIONALE CAPTURE step 2.9 in SKILL.md) after going 5-for-5 on its first day. Capture is now two AskUserQuestion steps since the tool hard-caps at 4 custom options per question and 5 standing buckets don't fit in one ask. Step 1 is direction-aware (same day, user request): a buy (qty_diff > 0) is asked 'was this DCA?' first, a sell (qty_diff < 0) is asked 'was this a stop-loss?' first; step 2 shows whichever 4 of the 5 reasons step 1 didn't already rule out.
